text:
A king is ruined by bad counsel, an ascetic by attachment, and a son by over-indulgence.
A scholar by lack of study, a lineage by a wicked descendant, and character by the company of the evil.
Modesty by intoxication, agriculture by neglect, and affection by long separation.
Friendship by lack of love, prosperity by lack of guidance, and wealth by careless abandonment.
